title: Woods Building Services v Milton Keynes Council
description: Milton Keynes Council ran a competitive tender for an asbestos removal and reinstatement services contract valued at approximately £8 million over a 4-year term. Woods Building Services, the incumbent provider, submitted the cheapest bid but was informed that the contract would be awarded to European Asbestos Services (EAS). Woods challenged the award alleging manifest error in the scoring of individual quality criteria and breach of transparency and equal treatment obligations. The court found that the Council's tender evaluation process was fundamentally flawed across multiple scoring items and ordered the Council to set aside its contract award decision.
